name: paper-voice
description: Read and listen to PDF papers: a reflowed reading view with equations and figures as typeset, continuous PDF pages, and Cartesia or OpenAI text-to-speech with highlighted passages.

scripts.lint: eslint app lib desktop tests scripts
scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/pdfjs-assets.mjs && vite build --config desktop/vite.config.mjs && node desktop/prepare.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test: node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-phrases.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-decimals.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-equations.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-lists.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-reflow.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-pdf.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-buffer.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-selection.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-playback.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-ipad-speech.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs tests/verify-reader.mjs
